trial_title: Effect of Pulse Width With Spinal Cord Stimulation
brief_summary: The primary objective of this study is to assess the effects of varying pulse width in suprathreshold dorsal column stimulation in patients with low back pain.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have chronic low back pain following spine surgery (Failed Back Surgery Syndrome), which is primarily located in the low back, with minimal lower extremity pain.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has chronic pain but it is not specifically low back pain following spine surgery, and they have significant lower extremity pain.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have been permanently implanted with a Precision spinal cord stimulation (SCS) system within 6 months, or be an appropriate candidate for SCS and for the surgical procedures required for SCS as determined by the physician and have independently selected SCS with Precision for treatment.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been implanted with a Precision spinal cord stimulation system and there is no indication they are an appropriate candidate for it.

eligibility_table.criterion: Be 18 years of age or older.
Be willing and able to comply with all study related procedures and visits.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not indicated any unwillingness to comply with study procedures, but their complex medical history raises some concerns.

eligibility_table.criterion: Be capable of reading and understanding patient information materials and giving written informed consent.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is likely capable of reading and understanding materials, but their medical condition may affect their ability to give informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have any significant medical condition that is likely to interfere with study procedures or likely to confound evaluation of study endpoints.
eligibility_table.justification: While the patient has multiple significant medical conditions, it is unclear if they would specifically interfere with study procedures or endpoints.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have any other chronic pain condition likely to confound evaluation of study endpoints.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has chronic pain from anaplastic astrocytoma and other conditions, but it is not clear if these would confound the evaluation of study endpoints.
